title: The Inadvertent Wrestling Debut of DJ Cummerbund
description:

I was invited by New York Wrestling Connection to attend their big event - Hotter Than Hell - at Tropix in Freeport, NY on August 27, 2018.
Elated to come and entertain and thrill the fans in attendance, my elation quickly turned to umbrage as I was harassed and berated by the extremely rude audience members who shouted terrible things at me and made obscene gestures at me while I was trying to delight them.
Then - if that wasn't bad enough - pro wrestler Bull James interrupts and ATTACKS me right in front of everyone while I was simply trying to do my job!
He mocked me right to my face and then viciously assaulted me as I was attempting to diffuse the situation. After he blindsided me, he stole my property - the World Mashup Championship belt that I had recently been awarded - and threw it right in the ocean. One top of being a bully, Bull James revealed to the world that he is also a LITTERBUG!
The disrespectful, ungrateful fans egged him on the whole time, and I place the majority of the blame on THEM. I take time out of my busy schedule to come entertain them...and this is the thanks I get?
Please feel free to let NYWC know how upset you are with their treatment of the #1 DJ in the world, DJ Cummerbund, by messaging and emailing them about this heinous treatment:
